name: kiro-security-power
description: A Kiro-native security workbench rebuilt from the Codex Security 0.1.11 architecture.

kiroSecurity.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to a Python 3.9+ executable used by the Kiro Security Power MCP server.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run clean && npm run compile && node scripts/prepare-dist.mjs && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out dist/kiro-security-power.vsix
scripts.test:node: node --test tests/approval.test.mjs tests/contracts.test.mjs tests/hook.test.mjs tests/integration-files.test.mjs tests/packaging.test.mjs tests/runtime.test.mjs tests/view.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run package:list
